edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the sender via _msgSender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as recipient and spender for the allowance decrease.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_transfer indirectly relies on the onlyOwner check comparing _owner to _msgSender.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender.
claimTokens is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
clearStuckBalance is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
claimOtherTokens is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
airdrop is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
allowtrading is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
setMarketingWallet is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
lock sets _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, making the lock timestamp dependent.
unlock requires block.timestamp > _lockTime, making ownership restoration timestamp dependent.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer.
_transfer can trigger swapAndLiquify, which performs external calls during a user transfer.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded when the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded when the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard calls _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_transferToExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_transferFromExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_transferBothExcluded calls _reflectFee.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal reflection supply.
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal accumulated fees.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_transferToExcluded credits _tOwned for the excluded recipient.
_transferFromExcluded debits _tOwned for the excluded sender.
_transferBothExcluded adjusts _tOwned for both parties.
_takeLiquidity credits _rOwned of the contract address.
_takeLiquidity credits _tOwned when the contract is excluded.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping consumed by approve.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for non-excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _tOwned for excluded accounts.
balanceOf branches on _isExcluded.
_tokenTransfer requires sender == owner() while canTrade is false, restricting early trading.
_tokenTransfer checks botWallets to block blacklisted traders.
_tokenTransfer requires botscantrade when a bot wallet is involved.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to apply fees.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
_transfer checks inSwapAndLiquify to avoid circular liquidity events.
_transfer compares the sender against uniswapV2Pair to avoid swapping on buys.
_transfer enforces the _maxWalletSize limit on fee-bearing recipients.
_transfer compares the contract balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer calls balanceOf to determine the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which performs the external router swap.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity after paying marketing.
swapAndLiquify sends ETH to marketingWallet before liquidity accounting completes.
The lockTheSwap modifier sets inSwapAndLiquify around swapAndLiquify.
swapAndLiquify computes the marketing share using marketingFeePercent.
swapAndLiquify sends funds to the mutable marketingWallet address.
swapTokensForEth performs the external swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
swapTokensForEth invokes uniswapV2Router, an externally controlled contract.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _allowances.
addLiquidity performs the external payable addLiquidityETH call.
addLiquidity invokes uniswapV2Router with ETH value.
addLiquidity approves the router through _allowances.
addLiquidity sends the resulting LP tokens to owner().
claimTokens transfers the whole contract ETH balance to marketingWallet.
claimTokens pays out to the mutable marketingWallet address.
clearStuckBalance transfers the contract balance to an arbitrary address.
claimOtherTokens transfers arbitrary ERC20 balances out of the contract.
lock zeroes _owner after storing the previous owner.
lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
lock writes the new _lockTime value.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock reads _previousOwner to authorize and restore ownership.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rOwned of the caller.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rTotal reflection supply.
deliver increases _tFeeTotal by the delivered token amount.
airdrop runs a fee-free transfer through the _tokenTransfer path.
airdrop removes and restores _taxFee via removeAllFee and restoreAllFee.
allowtrading flips the canTrade flag controlling who may trade.
The ETH transfer to marketingWallet can re-enter _transfer before accounting settles.
The arbitrary ETH transfer in clearStuckBalance can call back into _transfer logic.
The external router swap callback can re-enter the token transfer logic while inSwapAndLiquify is set.

normalization_plan.reason: The from address parameter only exists to feed the _transfer transfer logic.
The to address parameter only exists to feed the _transfer transfer logic.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by _transfer for limit checks and accounting.
The token balance argument is used only inside swapAndLiquify.
The token amount argument is consumed only by the swap routine.
The time parameter is only added to block.timestamp inside lock.
The sender parameter is used only by _tokenTransfer dispatch and bot checks.
The recipient parameter is used only by _tokenTransfer dispatch and bot checks.
The takeFee flag selects fee removal and the transfer variant inside _tokenTransfer.
Temporary half balance used only within swapAndLiquify.
Temporary remainder balance used only within swapAndLiquify.
Transient ETH accounting value local to swapAndLiquify.
Transient marketing ETH share computed and paid inside swapAndLiquify.
Reflection rate computed locally to credit liquidity in _takeLiquidity.
Net transferred token amount produced and used only by _transferStandard.
The ERC20 token argument is used only by claimOtherTokens.
The destination address argument is used only by claimOtherTokens.
